```{r}
# filter design file to keep only pertinent samples
xp_design = xp_design %>% 
  filter(Group %in% c(Denom, Numer))
head(xp_design)
# reorder counts columns according to the complete list of samples 
raw_counts <- raw_counts[ , xp_design$Sample]
head(raw_counts)
# Filter count file accordingly (to keep only samples present in the filtered xp_design file)
raw_counts_filtered = raw_counts[, colnames(raw_counts) %in% xp_design$Sample]
head(raw_counts_filtered)
```

```{r}
## Creation of the DESeqDataSet
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(raw_counts_filtered), 
                              colData = xp_design, 
                              design = ~ Group)
dds
```
```{r}
#Make sure the 'control' is presented first, a positive gene fold change means that the gene is upregulated in the 'experiment'/second condition relative to the 'control'/first condition
dds[[Category]]
```
```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```
```{r}
all_genes_results <- results(dds, contrast = c(Category,                      # name of the factor
                                  Numer,    # name of the numerator level for fold change
                                  Denom))                          # name of the denominator level    

mcols(all_genes_results)
resultsnames <- resultsNames(dds)
```
```{r}
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, 
                  res = all_genes_results,
                  type = "normal",
                  coef = resultsnames[2]) # name or number of the coefficient (LFC) to shrink
```

```{r}
# volcano plot
volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(toptable = all_genes_results,              # We use the shrunken log2 fold change as noise associated with low count genes is removed 
                x = "log2FoldChange",           # Name of the column in resLFC that contains the log2 fold changes
                y = "padj",                     # Name of the column in resLFC that contains the p-value
                lab = rownames(all_genes_results),
                xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ 'fold change'),
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                FCcutoff = 1,
                pointSize = 1.0,
                labSize = 2.0,
                title = paste(Numer, " vs. ", Denom, sep = ""),
                legendLabSize = 4.0,
                legendIconSize = 1.0,
                max.overlaps = 50
                )
volcano
ggsave(paste(OutPath, "/", Numer, "Vs", Denom, "Volcano.png", sep=""), volcano,device = 'png')
```
